run_controlnet_training: run the ControlNet training script on Habana Gaudi with a pretrained Stable Diffusion model and dataset
run_validation: run validation by generating images from prompts and conditioning images using the GaudiStableDiffusionControlNetPipeline
create_image_grid: create a grid image from a list of PIL images arranged in specified rows and columns
create_train_dataset: create a training dataset with image transforms, conditioning images, and tokenized captions for ControlNet training
save_model_card: save a model card README with training details and example images to a Hugging Face Hub repo folder
